problem.title: More software doesn't mean less paper.
problem.lead: Farms run on phone calls, WhatsApp, notebooks and paper invoices. Management software stays empty because nobody has time to retype it all.

cards.title: Work the way you do today.
cards.body: Documents and messages keep coming through the usual channels. Forward them to Seminai and it takes care of the rest.

cards.title: The right data, in the right place.
cards.body: Even a pen note on an invoice ends up on the right plot.

cards.title: No endless setup.
cards.body: No 35 steps before you can start: upload your documents and the farm records build up from there.

how.title: How it works.
how.lead: Three steps. The first takes thirty seconds.

steps.title: Reads messy documents.
steps.body: Crooked photos, scans, PDFs, handwritten notes: Seminai extracts products, quantities, lots, dates and plots.

steps.title: Connects the data.
steps.body: The same harvest goes from the field to the truck to the silo. Seminai keeps together the documents that talk about the same thing.

steps.title: Gives it back the way you need it.
steps.body: Ask in chat, download as Excel or PDF, fill in the field logbook.

useCases.title: What you can do with your data.
useCases.lead: Once extracted, the data is yours: query it, export it, reuse it.

items.question: How is Seminai different from management software?
items.answer: It doesn't ask you to change habits or retype data. It starts from the documents you already receive and turns them into organized data. It fills the system for you.

items.question: What documents does it read?
items.answer: Invoices, delivery notes, labels, farm records, handwritten logs and notes. As photos, PDFs, scans or forwarded emails. No need to sort them first.

items.question: Can it read handwriting?
items.answer: Yes: notes, notebooks and pen annotations on invoices. Every value stays linked to the original document, so you can check it in a moment.

items.question: What if it reads a value wrong?
items.answer: Every value links back to its source document. If something is off you see it right away and fix it in one click. You review, approve and sign the field logbook.

items.question: Does it connect to the software I already use?
items.answer: Yes, through APIs. Or export the data to Excel or PDF and take it wherever you need.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: It is encrypted in transit and at rest, on European servers. It is not shared with third parties or used to train AI models. You can export or delete it anytime.
